name: backbone-plugin
description: Backbone agent-driven tenant setup: skills and slash commands that drive configure-to-build through the Backbone MCP server (the hosted service).

backbone_url.title: Backbone URL
backbone_url.description: Leave this as it is: it is the hosted Backbone service. Change it only when Calon names another Backbone service for you, and then enter it exactly as given: it must start with https:// and have no trailing slash, query or port. Never enter an http:// address or any other host.
